verdict.rationale: Linear documents customer-request intake through integrations (Slack channels, Intercom, Front), manual customer creation, and automatic conversion of feedback into issues. Nothing in the evidence describes a user-facing feedback portal, or a shareable link a developer could embed in their own product to send users to one. Feedback intake is a fair axis for a product-planning tool, so the verdict is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal
